headline: Updates on library use, finances, and the building, plus other business.
summary: Reports on library use, finances, and building work are on the agenda. Other business is listed last.

S A L E M  P U B L I C  L I B R A R Y

Salem, Massachusetts 01970 
TARA MANSFIELD, Director 
Board of Library Trustees Meeting 
November 19, 2026 
4:00PM 
 
Notice is hereby given that a meeting of the Board of Library Trustees will be held on November19, 2026 
at 4:00 p.m. via remote participation pursuant to Section 30A of chapter 20 of the acts of 2021, as 
amended by 2 section 40 of chapter 2 of the acts of 2023, and further amended by Section 1 of 
Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2025, the City is authorized to conduct remote meetings of its public 
bodies through June 30, 2027. 
Join Zoom Meeting 
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88257084935?pwd=KmbaVIhTlkKi4c6RyUiOz4FGZ9jCnZ.1 
 
Meeting ID: 882 5708 4935 
Passcode: 728397 
 
 
1. Call of Roll 
2. Approval of Minutes of September 17, 2026 
3. Library Use 
4. Finances 
5. Building Update 
6. Other Business 
7. Adjournment 
Know Your Rights Under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A ss. 18-25 and City Ordinance Sections 
2-2028 through 2-2033. 
Persons requiring auxiliary aids and services for effective communication such as sign language 
interpreter, an assistive listening device, or print material in digital format or a reasonable modification in 
programs, services, policies, or activities, may contact the City of Salem ADA Coordinator as soon as 
possible and no less than 2 business days before the meeting, program, or event. 
 
 
Respectfully submitted by: 
 
Tara Mansfield, Library Director

19 de noviembre de 2026 
4:00PM 
 
Por la presente se notifica que se celebrará una reunión de la Junta de Síndicos de la Biblioteca el 
19 de noviembre de 2026, a las 4:00 p.m., mediante participación remota; de conformidad con la 
Sección 30A del Capítulo 20 de las Leyes de 2021 —modificada por la Sección 40 del Capítulo 
2 de las Leyes de 2023 y modificada nuevamente por la Sección 1 del Capítulo 2 de las Leyes de 
2025, la Ciudad está autorizada para celebrar reuniones remotas de sus organismos públicos 
hasta el 30 de junio de 2027. 
Unirse a la reunión de Zoom

Las personas que requieran ayudas y servicios auxiliares para una comunicación efectiva, como un

con el Coordinador ADA de la Ciudad de Salem lo antes possible y no menos de 2 días hábiles antes de la

Tara Mansfield, Directora de la Biblioteca
